lead.headline: Lost by 15 on Monday night; now two byes and Love still at quarterback
lead.deck: 2-5. Claim Hockenson and Bass before 01:00 Wednesday, and put Allen in before Thursday's kickoff.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Week 7 is lost: JuiceJam 105.22, AVIATO 89.76, after CeeDee Lamb scored 24.4 and Dameon Pierce 11.8 on Monday night when they needed 20.75 between them. Garrett Wilson managed 4.6 on three targets, Jefferson 8.4 and Likely 3.2; 8.6 points sat on the bench, not enough to change it. AVIATO are 2-5. Week 8 starts with three holes: Love is still at quarterback from Buffalo's bye and plays Thursday, which locks him in; Likely (Giants) and Fairbairn (Texans) are on bye with no cover on the roster. Three moves fix it — Allen in, and claims on T.J. Hockenson and Tyler Bass, which clear at 01:00 Wednesday. Jalen Coker is limited with a shoulder and plays Thursday; Wilson covers him if he sits.

doFirst.headline: Two claims before Wednesday 01:00, one swap before Thursday
doFirst.deck: Hockenson (Henry behind him) for Love, Bass for Fairbairn; Allen in at QB.
doFirst.note: Chem's priority resets weekly — order the claims Hockenson, Henry, Bass. Coker is checked Thursday 16:45.

cards.reason: Shoulder, limited on Monday's estimate. Coker 14.6, Wilson 14.1 — a coin flip the projection gives Coker.
rows: Coker starts; Wilson stays on the bench

cards.headline: Allen in before Thursday; Tuten into the RB slot
cards.reason: Love plays Thursday and locks the QB slot at kickoff. Tuten and Allen are back from byes.
rows: Tuten at RB, Gordon to flex, Metcalf to bench
